sloka: लाङ्गूलानि प्रविध्यन्तः स्फोटयन्तश्च वानराः।लक्ष्मणो जयतीत्येवं वाक्यं विश्रावयंस्तदा ।। ६.९१.९६ ।।
transliteration: lāṅgūlāni pravidhyantaḥ sphoṭayantaśca vānarāḥ।lakṣmaṇo jayatītyevaṁ vākyaṁ viśrāvayaṁstadā ।। 6.91.96 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys feeling very happy embraced one another singing in praise of Lakshmana saying" Lakshmana has won"and stories related to Lakshmana
